newsitem.title: USA: Quality Dining Q4 aided by Bruegger's.
newsitem.headline: Quality Dining Q4 aided by Bruegger's.

text.p: Quality Dining Inc said its recent acquisition of Bruegger's Bagels helped boost its fiscal fourth quarter revenues by 137 percent, and the company is focused on continuing to expand the Bruegger's chain.

"The full resources of our company are focused on the goal of expanding Bruegger's segment leading position," said Daniel Fitzpatrick, chairman, president and chief executive officer of Quality Dining.
Earlier, Quality Dining reported net earnings for its fiscal fourth quarter ended October 27 of $2.82 million, up from $1.77 million last year. Revenues were $64.995 million, versus $27.404 million.
The company said it opened 66 new Bruegger's Bagel Bakeries, one Papa Vino's Italian Kitchen restaurant and one Chili's Grill & Bar restaurant during the quarter.
Quality Dining completed its acquisition of Bruegger's in June.

"With Bruegger's at the forefront, we experienced outstanding growth and development during the fourth quarter," Fitzpatrick said in a statement. "Clearly, Bruegger's represents the driving force in our aggressive expansion."
